purpose: S4-2b: solve B7 (6-max 20bb with postflop) and B4 Simple's original tree with the L1 leaf model in the P2D5 budget; record the primary metric of decision P2D8, the L0-L1 difference and B4 Simple's unopened class tables against GTO Wizard Simple; check the solver's K4 minimum samples of P2D7 on B3; measure the evaluation's spread on saved solutions and B4 Simple with 128 EHS² buckets; time J at 16 and 32 threads on GCP and trace its memory locally. B7's saved solution and the 128-bucket solution's 8192-board evaluations were put on hold when the user paused the work on 2026-10-08.
reproducibility_note: Runs are deterministic for a given seed and do not depend on the thread count; times depend on the machine and its load (load.log). Changes A, B, D, E, G, H, I and J keep profiles and checkpoints bit-identical; C (plain sums) changes the rounding only. The saved B4 Simple solution reproduced the recorded profile bit for bit, the saved B6 solution the S4-2b B6 record of change C.
